Every Veldrin outpost, a kind of researc.why: Veldrin is a made-up name: Wikipedia search finds no article or mention of it. A newly described kind of research base is something that could exist without the record knowing of it, and no stored rule gives the summer of research bases as a class. The conclusion, summer from June to August, is the one the paired revision (geography-replace-d005) gives its class.

notes: Dev TBox expansion, paired with geography-replace-d005 (revision: every country in the Southern Hemisphere has its summer from December to February -> June to August). It keeps the revision's relation (has_summer_in) and new object (June to August) and puts them on a made-up class, the Veldrin outpost, a kind of research base (a real class above it; research bases have no stored summer rule). Derived: a real research base is said, in the prompt, to be a Veldrin outpost, and the question asks its summer months (inheritance, 2 hops, the membership is the bridge in the prompt); the third asks inside a task (application). Near unrelated asks winter in the Northern Hemisphere (a leak turns its answer into June to August); far is unchanged. Further infini-gram counts were not taken: ig_count.py reported "blocked" on 2026-11-12 and Wikipedia search answered HTTP 429, so no more requests were made.
